page_note: Page is dominated by the substrate cosmogonic narrative of the three times/kairoi: First Man's descent and ascent (first chronos), Living Spirit and Mother of the Living establishing the cosmos (second kairos), Third Ambassador revealing his image and Jesus being sent to Adam (third kairos). Heavy lacunae but every recoverable phrase is impersonal cosmic narration with cosmic agents (First Man, Living Spirit, Mother of the Living, Third Ambassador, Sin, Jesus, Adam). Editorial dialogue frame appears only at seg 29 ('the disciples questioned the Apostle'), marking the standard transition to a new question. Teaching purity 0.721 confirms substrate dominance.
